EN1_state_reliability_notes: Transition gate is cluster-concentrated: 88% (Exp1) and 96% (Exp2) of transition-gated cells fall in two clusters; the main transition cluster is 98% mutant RFP (Exp1 cluster 11) and 90% of mutant transition cells sit in it.

AT1 gate (>=2 of Ager/Hopx/Clic5) is not cluster-concentrated: 17-18% of cells in pure AT2 clusters pass it; top-2 clusters hold only 43% (Exp1) / 51% (Exp2) of AT1-gate cells. 'mixed' state largely reflects low-level Ager/Hopx detection in AT2 cells, not a mature AT1 population; no distinct AT1 cluster exists in these sorted libraries.

Cd177-positive cells concentrate in one high-depth cluster per experiment (Exp1 cluster 12: 96% 2-week mutant RFP, 21% Cd177>=1, 51% AT1 gate, 25% cycling>=2; Exp2 cluster 11: 13% Cd177>=1, 43% AT1 gate, 21% cycling).

Immune clusters retain 30-56% of cells under the primary rule (Exp1 clusters 6/7); strict rule removes more. Depth differs strongly across clusters (median UMIs 3.3k-13.8k); depth-thinned variants are essential for EN2-EN5.
